(Available in Demo)[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
[h2]New fancy magic weapon and more![/h2]
Rune Scepter is a primary weapon for people that love combining spells.

LMB: Charge one RED (+damage) stack.
RMB: Charge one BLUE (+reveal duration) stack.
At 3 charges, cast the spell assigned to this specific order of colors. You can cast spells from a range of 8 different spells:
[list]
[*]Leap
[*]Barrage
[*]Boomerang
[*]Shield
[*]Slash
[*]Gravity Burst
[*]Buff
[*]Slow Area
[/list]
The game now also features a Chat and improved player feedback for cooldowns.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Networking Update![/b]
The whole networking layer has been replaced from a Host - Client model to Distributed Authority, meaning there will no longer be a host, and everyone plays as Client instead. The connection is established over a light weight relay server, so your IP address will remain hidden.

Distributed Authority has the following benefits over the traditional Host - Client model:
[list]
[*] ~50% lower latency between Clients.
[*] No more unfair Host-advantage.
[*] Client to Client connection isn't dependent on the internet speed of one Host.
[*] Network workload is better spread amongst all players.
[/list]
